title: Action of 17 July 1628
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Action of 17 July 1628", at revision 1371464896, opens: "The action of 17 July 1628 took place during the Anglo-French War (1627–1629). The English force led by the Kirke brothers succeeded in capturing a supply convoy bound for New France, severely impairing that colony's ability to resist attack." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4677272, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1628 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
